we_boards.use: optional Write Everywhere layouts (another fleet): each face is the board's flat printable quad, unobstructed (its frame ring sits outside the face, 0.03 m proud); role blank = an empty panel left for the player's own label, name = a lit name board (sheet kind) a WE text may cover
we_boards.frame: centre / normal / right / up in prefab-local game metres; game (gx, gy, gz) = authoring (y, z, x) = FBX-raw (x, z, -y); gx NOT negated (the school's / every shipped building row's convention). build/probes-b.md section 2: the game appears to negate FBX x; probe X2 decides; branch N = S1b negates gx of every row with gx != 0 and mirrors yaw (q.y -> -q.y). Identity rows (role signset) are frame-free.

sub_objects.frame: game local (gx, gy, gz) = authoring (y, z, x); rotation (x, y, z, w)
sub_objects.notes: ObjectSubObjects on the hand-made prefab: m_GroupIndex 0, m_Probability 100; m_ParentMesh per object (-1 = on the lot, 0 = attached to the main mesh: wall lights, deck props); GUIDs = the variant family's placeholder (design/detail-pass-1.md 1.6), whitelisted in tools/preflight.ps1 at the surgery round
